If you work fifty hours a week and your employer declares twenty-five, then as far as the State is concerned you worked twenty-five.

6. Se ti sfruttano puoi denunciare senza: 6. If you are being exploited you can report it without losing your permit
La paura è sempre la stessa, ed è compre: The fear is always the same, and it is understandable: "if I speak up, they will send me home". It is that fear that keeps the system standing.
La legge italiana prevede però il contra: Italian law provides the opposite. For victims of serious labour exploitation who cooperate with the authorities there are
— previsti dal Testo Unico sull'immigraz: — set out in the Consolidated Immigration Act — that protect those who report rather than punishing them. Labour exploitation through middlemen, known as
, è un reato punito dall'articolo 603-bi: , is a crime under article 603-bis of the criminal code.
I segnali sono concreti: paga molto sott: The signs are concrete: pay far below the contract rate, hours with no limit, no rest day, documents taken away, accommodation in overcrowded rooms deducted from wages, transport imposed on you and paid for by you. If you recognise more than one, it is not normal and it already matters in law.
Metti al sicuro i tuoi documenti: fai fo: Keep your documents safe: photograph your passport and permit and keep the images somewhere only you control. No employer has the right to hold your originals.
Raccogli quello che puoi senza metterti: Gather what you can without putting yourself in danger: payslips, messages, names, working hours, photos of the accommodation.
Parla prima con un patronato, un sindaca: Talk first to a patronato, a union or an anti-trafficking association: they explain what reporting involves and what protection you are entitled to,
Puoi segnalare all'Ispettorato del Lavor: You can report to the Labour Inspectorate without filing a criminal complaint. There is also a national anti-trafficking freephone line, open day and night and free of charge: 800 290 290.
Le condizioni per ottenere questi permes: The conditions for these permits are precise and must be assessed case by case: get help from a patronato, an association or a lawyer before you act.
7. La formazione sulla sicurezza in una: 7. Safety training in a language you understand is your right
In magazzino, in cantiere, in cucina cap: In a warehouse, on a building site, in a kitchen, someone puts a sheet in front of you to sign: it is the certificate for a safety course. Sometimes you never attended the course. Sometimes you did, but it was all in technical Italian and you understood almost nothing.
La legge italiana sulla sicurezza sul la: Italian workplace safety law is not satisfied that a course was delivered: it requires that the information and training be
, and that understanding be verified. If you do not yet speak Italian well, the employer must take that into account.
Non è un cavillo. Se un giorno succede u: This is not a technicality. If an accident happens one day, the difference between "he had been trained" and "he had signed a paper he could not read" changes responsibility entirely — and changes what you and your family are owed.

Chiedi copia degli attestati dei corsi c: Ask for copies of the certificates for courses you really did attend and keep them: you will need them if you change job.
Se ti negano la formazione o ti fanno fi: If you are denied training or made to sign something untrue, you can report it to the Labour Inspectorate, confidentially if you wish.
Contenuti e durata dei corsi obbligatori: The content and length of compulsory courses depend on the sector and the job: check with your workers' safety representative, a union or the Inspectorate.
